requirements.Title: Business Ink Tank Printer
requirements.Description: Develop HP's first business-class ink tank printer (Magellan) targeting unmanaged and lightly managed SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses a gap in HP's portfolio for SMBs seeking cost-effective, high-performance printing solutions with low total cost of ownership (TCO).
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: A business ink tank printer is launched, available for SMB customers, with tank-based ink delivery and business-grade performance.

requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-powered productivity features, including Perfect Print and Perfect Scan, and AI-based device management for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: AI solutions differentiate HP from competitors, improve user experience, and address SMB needs for efficiency and manageability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI-powered print, scan, and device management features are available and functional in the Magellan printer, validated through user testing.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal (SMB portal) for easy management of printers by office managers and generalist IT staff in SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs lack IT resources; a consolidated portal simplifies device management and enhances user experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: A web-based portal is available for SMB customers, allowing them to manage, monitor, and configure their Magellan printers.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan delivers HP's lowest total cost of ownership (TCO) for business printing, with minimal intervention required.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a top priority for SMBs; lower TCO is a key competitive differentiator.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent testing confirms Magellan's TCO is lower than other HP business printers and leading competitors in the SMB segment.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – High Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Use at least 60% recycled content plastic (RCP) in the Magellan printer, exceeding competitors (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a growing customer requirement and a competitive differentiator for HP.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bill of Materials and third-party validation confirm at least 60% RCP in the printer's construction.

requirements.Title: Maintenance-Free or Low Maintenance Design
requirements.Description: Design Magellan to be maintenance-free or require minimal maintenance, with fewer parts to replace over its lifetime (e.g., replaceable maintenance box).
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require reliable, low-touch devices to reduce downtime and intervention costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Field tests show reduced maintenance interventions compared to prior HP SMB printers; replaceable maintenance box is available.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink Refilling
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and reduce user error.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents operational errors, ensures proper usage, and supports warranty/service requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink bottles are uniquely keyed to corresponding tanks; user testing confirms error prevention.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability
requirements.Description: Provide a warranty of 80,000 pages or 2 years (whichever comes first). Ensure customer-replaceable parts (PHA) and easy serviceability (MINK at service centre, target customer replaceable).
requirements.Rationale: SMBs value reliability and ease of service due to lack of IT staff; clear warranty terms increase purchase confidence.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty documentation specifies 80k pages/2 years; parts are designed for easy replacement by customers or service centers.

requirements.Title: Support for SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB Portal
requirements.Description: Non-PDL SKUs must support SMB2.0 Solutions and the Advanced View SMB portal. Support for PaaS (Platform as a Service).
requirements.Rationale: Aligns product with HP's evolving SMB solutions ecosystem and cloud-based management.
requirements.Dependencies: Business Ink Tank Printer, SMB Portal
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKUs are compatible with SMB2.0 Solutions and the Advanced View SMB portal; PaaS features are available.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU Performance and Compatibility
requirements.Description: PDL SKU must support print speeds of 25/20 ppm (improved from current 25/19), PDL/PS support, and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses higher performance and compliance needs for certain SMB segments; ensures competitiveness in regulated markets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves required print speeds, passes PDL/PS compatibility tests, and secures Blue Angel certification.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features to collect device usage, performance, and health data for ongoing improvement and support.
requirements.Rationale: Enables proactive support, product improvement, and data-driven decision-making for HP and customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Business Ink Tank Printer, SMB Portal
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is securely collected, stored, and accessible for analysis; complies with privacy regulations.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing Support via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing capabilities through the HP App for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: Mobile printing is a key use case for SMBs with flexible work environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can print from mobile devices via the HP App with high reliability and ease of use.

requirements.Title: Platform as a Service (PaaS) Support
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan supports Platform as a Service (PaaS) for flexible deployment and management.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP's strategy for solutions monetization and cloud-based service delivery.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS features are implemented and tested for SMB customers.
